name: Milanote
description_en:
Milanote is a product in the Note taking category. Its directory profile covers Recurring Tasks, To-do List, Share Link, File Sharing, Real-time Collaboration, Task Tracking, Templates.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.99. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: make files available to authorized participants; reuse predefined layouts or workflow structures. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
